answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring cryptographic attestation to unique biological traits, functioning as the fundamental timber of identity integrity. An attacker attempting to inject fake nodes faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring rare biological pigment markers to bypass biometric verification. Without this, the system would spiral into chaotic node saturation, forcing the adversary to expend massive capital on fraudulent physical authentications that the network effectively deems worthless.
